label: Tuition fee (non-EU full-degree students)
notes: The official portal states: 'Annual tuition fees for full-degree students USD 8,000-21,000 / Euro 6,000-16,000 (DKK 45,000-120,000).' EU/EEA citizens and those with permanent or certain temporary residence permits study for free; the portal says: 'All other students must pay tuition fees.' Individual programme fees in our catalogue come from each programme's own portal record (stated per term there; annual = 2 x per term).

provenance.source: Study in Denmark - Tuition Fees and Scholarships
